aiResearchSummary.text: Arc Boats is engaged in developing watercraft featuring an adjustable tower assembly, as described in a design where a support structure moves between positions in response to actuation. They are also working on watercraft with a liquid cooled display, which maintains high brightness, and on electric boats with a battery system that can be repositioned within the hull to adjust the center of gravity. These efforts focus on structural adaptability, display cooling, and battery placement.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $50,000,000, or 33.33% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $20,000, representing 0.01% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $21,590,289 to $549,849,353, a 25.47x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
